description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the estimated parameters ratio (in percent) on the x-axis and the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) on the y-axis for four different model configurations: “Transformer” (red dashed line with square markers), “Only MoHD FFN” (gray solid line with square markers), “Only MoHD ATTN” (dark blue solid line with circular markers), and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (light blue solid line with star markers). The x-axis, labeled “Estimated Parameters Ratio(%)”, spans from approximately 50% to 100%, with tick marks at 50, 75, and 100. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL”, ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The “Transformer” baseline remains relatively flat, starting at around 11.7 at 100% and slightly increasing to 12.1 at 50%. “Only MoHD FFN” begins at 11.7 at 100%, drops slightly to 11.6 at 75%, then rises to 13.1 at 50%. “Only MoHD ATTN” starts at 11.7 at 100%, increases to 12.0 at 75%, and sharply climbs to 13.3 at 50%. “MoHD ATTN + MLP” begins at 11.7 at 100%, rises to 12.1 at 75%, and then surges to 14.2 at 50%, showing the steepest increase among all configurations as parameter ratio decreases.
